recentItems.title: Tan France Tells All | Being Queer | Bollywood Parties
recentItems.description:
Television personality, fashion designer and Queer Eye fame Tan France talks to Haroon to talk about growing up queer in a British Pakistani household, moving to the US, and how he’s received compared to contemporaries like Riz Ahmed and Hasan Minhaj. He also spoke about his love for Bollywood and meeting Chunky Panday and spending Diwali at Amitabh Bachchan’s house!

#TanFrance #BBC #Bollywood #QueerEye
